proposals.evidence: DEDR 3630 compares Tamil naṉai (past naṉaint-), Malayalam nanayuka and Gondi nānd-/nān- become wet. The selected participial survey responses retain this intransitive wetting stem; causatives and compounds remain separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
